name: Trakstar Hire
niche: applicant tracking within a performance platform
notes: Site says: "We are constantly working to integrate Trakstar products with the latest and greatest HR tools" Hiring product posts job descriptions to job boards. Pricing page asks for a quote and shows no prices. Header, footer and integrations pages mention no API, developer docs or partner program. Address on the about page is under a Contact Us label, not a headquarters label.

review.note: Homepage, pricing, about, integrations, hire product page and footer read; pricing is quote-only and no API or partner program is mentioned.
